overview.zh: 这张总览图把操作者在上位机中的操作与后端控制、P4 状态和安全保护联系起来。各模式的完整状态变化位于可下钻的子图；本图用于先定位功能入口，具体是否允许执行仍以对应条件和源码为准。
overview.en: This overview connects operator actions in the desktop application to backend control, P4 state, and safety protection. Detailed state changes live in the linked subgraphs. Use this map to locate each feature; whether an action is accepted still depends on its specific source-backed guards.

zh.plain: 操作者通过上位机界面选择设备、控制模式和动作。点击只会启动上位机中的处理流程；连接状态、当前模式和安全检查仍可能阻止命令继续。
zh.condition: 本总览节点代表用户操作入口，没有单独的布尔准入条件；各按钮的具体条件见对应子图。
zh.effect: 界面事件进入上位机控制代码，再由该代码决定是否连接设备、更新状态或发送控制请求。
zh.failure: 设备未连接、选中的电机或编码器不可用、状态不允许等情况会使具体操作被拦截；不能把按钮点击等同于电机已经动作。
zh.recovery: 根据具体操作的提示连接设备、切换到兼容模式、补齐端点或先处理故障，再重新操作。
zh.unknown: 总览图不记录实际设备运行结果；实际响应需要查看实时状态或设备日志。
zh.difference: 不同按钮进入不同控制子图，负责的操作及准入条件不同。
zh.change: 相对于本次比较基线，源码清单未标记该入口或模式节点发生变更；此处因此不声称运行行为改变。

en.plain: The operator selects a device, control mode, or action in the desktop UI. A click starts an upper-computer workflow; connection state, the active mode, and safety checks can still block the command.
en.condition: This overview node represents the user entry point and has no single Boolean guard. See the relevant subgraph for each button's actual conditions.
en.effect: The UI event enters desktop control code, which decides whether to connect, update state, or send a control request.
en.failure: An operation can be blocked when the device is disconnected, a selected motor or encoder is unavailable, or the current state rejects it. A click does not prove that a motor moved.
en.recovery: Follow the operation's status message: connect the device, switch to a compatible mode, complete required endpoints, or clear the fault before retrying.
en.unknown: The overview contains no observed hardware result; confirm actual response in live state or device logs.
en.difference: Different buttons enter different control subgraphs with different jobs and guards.
en.change: The source manifest does not mark this entry or mode node as changed against the comparison baseline, so no behavior change is claimed here.

zh.plain: 连接流程选择串口并请求上位机连接 P4。连接成功后清空旧状态缓存并等待下位机状态和舵机反馈同步，避免继续显示上一次会话的数据。
zh.condition: 需要选中有效串口；若已经连接，代码报告当前连接并返回成功，不会重复打开端口。
zh.effect: 连接前重置状态快照与缓冲区、清理实时显示；连接成功后保存端口并触发通信就绪处理。
zh.failure: 未选串口时返回失败并显示状态；端口打开失败时提示连接失败，不能据此认为 P4 已联机。
zh.recovery: 刷新端口列表，检查设备和端口选择，再重新连接；连接后等待状态与反馈同步。
zh.unknown: 串口底层通信是否稳定需通过运行时状态确认。
zh.difference: 连接是控制动作的前置通信步骤，不会单独启动 Joint 或 Motor 控制。
zh.change: 相对于本次比较基线，源码清单未标记该入口或模式节点发生变更；此处因此不声称运行行为改变。

en.plain: The connection flow selects a serial port and asks the desktop app to connect to P4. On success it clears the previous state buffer and waits for lower-controller status and servo feedback, avoiding stale data from the prior session.
en.condition: A valid port must be selected. If already connected, the code reports the current connection and returns success without opening it again.
en.effect: Before connecting, it resets the state snapshot and buffer and clears live displays. After success it records the port and runs communication-ready handling.
en.failure: With no selected port it reports failure; if opening the port fails, it shows a connection error. Neither case proves that P4 is online.
en.recovery: Refresh the port list, check the device and selection, reconnect, then wait for status and feedback synchronization.
en.unknown: Serial-link stability must be confirmed from runtime status.
en.difference: Connection establishes the communication prerequisite; it does not start Joint or Motor control by itself.
en.change: The source manifest does not mark this entry or mode node as changed against the comparison baseline, so no behavior change is claimed here.

zh.plain: 使能、暂停、停止和故障复位由上位机控制流程处理。ENABLE 会先检查启动条件，再按当前模式选择关节反馈控制或电机直控；恢复暂停目标也有单独的范围匹配判断。
zh.condition: 启动前要求通信可用、路由扫描结束、所选电机在线且可路由；非 Motor 模式还要求编码器在线，多圈坐标可信，并满足 P4 状态条件。
zh.effect: Joint 模式设置关节角控制并请求启动；Motor 模式建立当前位置保持后发送绝对目标。暂停恢复仅在允许标志和作用范围匹配时继续。
zh.failure: 任一前置检查失败都会返回并显示阻止原因；当前在 Device Check 子模式或启动校准恢复流程时，ENABLE 会被拒绝。
zh.recovery: 按提示等待路由扫描、恢复离线设备或可信多圈坐标；清除故障后返回 UNCONTROLLABLE，再重新 ENABLE。
zh.unknown: 各按钮对应的所有停止和暂停分支详见 control 子图；本节点概括启动准入。
zh.difference: Joint Channels 启动反馈控制器；Motor Channels 从实际反馈建立直接位置保持，两者启动命令不同。
zh.change: 相对于本次比较基线，源码清单未标记该入口或模式节点发生变更；此处因此不声称运行行为改变。

en.plain: Enable, pause, stop, and fault reset are handled by desktop control workflows. ENABLE checks prerequisites first, then chooses joint-feedback control or direct motor control. Resume also requires a separate scope match.
en.condition: Startup requires communication, a completed route scan, online and uniquely routed selected motors, trusted multi-turn coordinates, and—outside Motor mode—online encoders plus an allowed P4 state.
en.effect: Joint mode selects joint-angle control and requests controller start. Motor mode establishes a hold from current feedback before sending an absolute target. Resume proceeds only when its permission flag and scope match.
en.failure: Any failed prerequisite returns with a blocking status. ENABLE is also rejected during Device Check or while startup calibration recovery is running.
en.recovery: Follow the status: wait for route scanning, restore offline hardware or trusted multi-turn coordinates, clear the fault to UNCONTROLLABLE, then enable again.
en.unknown: The control subgraph contains the individual stop and pause branches; this node summarizes startup admission.
en.difference: Joint Channels starts a feedback controller; Motor Channels creates a direct position hold from measured feedback, so their start commands differ.
en.change: The source manifest does not mark this entry or mode node as changed against the comparison baseline, so no behavior change is claimed here.

zh.plain: Device Check 用于手动采集关节端点。操作者把当前 Raw 读数设为最小或最大端点，界面标记该关节有待保存的修改。
zh.condition: 只有目标关节存在可用的 Current Raw 数值时，采集动作才继续。
zh.effect: 代码将当前原始读数写入对应的最小值或最大值控件，并把该关节标记为已修改。
zh.failure: Raw 数值缺失时会显示 capture blocked 状态，不会用空值更新端点。
zh.recovery: 先恢复该关节的实时读数，再重新采集；保存和下发的完整步骤见 Device Check 子图。
zh.unknown: 本节点证据覆盖采集入口；端点持久化和固件采用时机需查看子图源码。
zh.difference: 这是人工端点采集入口，与自动标定流程分开。
zh.change: 相对于本次比较基线，源码清单未标记该入口或模式节点发生变更；此处因此不声称运行行为改变。

en.plain: Device Check lets an operator capture manual joint endpoints. The current Raw reading becomes the minimum or maximum endpoint, and the UI marks that joint as modified.
en.condition: Capture proceeds only when a Current Raw value is available for the selected joint.
en.effect: The code copies the raw reading into the selected minimum or maximum control and marks that joint dirty.
en.failure: If Raw is unavailable, the UI reports that capture is blocked and does not replace the endpoint with an empty value.
en.recovery: Restore a live reading for the joint and capture again. See the Device Check subgraph for saving and applying the endpoint.
en.unknown: This evidence covers the capture entry point; persistence and firmware adoption are detailed in the subgraph.
en.difference: This is the manual endpoint workflow, separate from automatic calibration.
en.change: The source manifest does not mark this entry or mode node as changed against the comparison baseline, so no behavior change is claimed here.

zh.plain: Joint Channels 按关节角目标发送控制请求。单行发送先确认控制交互已就绪，再记录用户目标并通过启动保护，之后才把关节目标交给后端。
zh.condition: 控制交互就绪且启动保护通过；具体包含哪些状态和硬件条件应结合 control 子图。
zh.effect: 为目标关节生成一次性目标，调用后端发送，并把该行标记为运行中。
zh.failure: 就绪检查或启动保护失败时提前返回，不调用后端发送。
zh.recovery: 检查当前模式、使能状态及保护提示，满足条件后再发送。
zh.unknown: 电机反馈如何闭环更新不由此单行发送函数单独证明，参见 Joint Channels 子图。
zh.difference: 该路径按关节命令发送，与 Motor Channels 按电机绝对位置直接控制不同。
zh.change: 相对于本次比较基线，源码清单未标记该入口或模式节点发生变更；此处因此不声称运行行为改变。

en.plain: Joint Channels sends a target expressed per joint. A single-row send first checks interaction readiness, records the user target, passes a start guard, and only then gives the joint targets to the backend.
en.condition: Control interaction must be ready and the start guard must pass. Consult the control subgraph for the full state and hardware checks.
en.effect: It builds a one-shot target for the joint, sends it through the backend, and marks the row as running.
en.failure: If readiness or the start guard fails, the function returns before calling the backend send.
en.recovery: Check the current mode, enable state, and protection message; retry after the stated prerequisites are met.
en.unknown: This single-row function alone does not prove how feedback closes the loop; see the Joint Channels subgraph.
en.difference: This path sends a joint-level command, unlike Motor Channels, which directly controls a motor's absolute position.
en.change: The source manifest does not mark this entry or mode node as changed against the comparison baseline, so no behavior change is claimed here.

zh.plain: Motor Channels 按单个电机发送绝对位置命令。发送前同步滑块数值，后端接受后记录已发送目标并清除该行的一次性目标状态。
zh.condition: 控制交互就绪并成功计算和发送绝对目标；失败时不会进入成功后的行状态更新。
zh.effect: 调用单电机绝对位置发送；成功后标记该行运行、清除已发送目标，并在多圈坐标可信时更新状态提示。
zh.failure: 交互保护拦截时立即退出；绝对命令没有成功发送时不执行后续成功状态更新。
zh.recovery: 根据上位机提示恢复通信、目标范围或多圈坐标，再重试。
zh.unknown: 绝对目标的 P4 状态准入和舵机级保护由下位机控制及安全子图说明。
zh.difference: 这是直接面向 M 通道的绝对位置控制；Joint Channels 面向关节角并由反馈控制器处理。
zh.change: 相对于本次比较基线，源码清单未标记该入口或模式节点发生变更；此处因此不声称运行行为改变。

en.plain: Motor Channels sends an absolute-position command for one motor. It synchronizes the slider value first; after a successful backend send it records the sent target and clears the row's one-shot target state.
en.condition: Control interaction must be ready and an absolute target must be calculated and sent. If sending fails, the success-state updates do not run.
en.effect: It sends one motor's absolute target. On success it marks the row running, clears the sent target, and updates status when multi-turn coordinates are trusted.
en.failure: An interaction guard returns immediately; a rejected absolute command does not reach the success updates.
en.recovery: Follow the desktop status to restore communication, a valid target range, or trusted multi-turn coordinates, then retry.
en.unknown: P4 admission and servo-level protection for this target are explained by the lower-controller and safety subgraphs.
en.difference: This directly controls an M-channel absolute position; Joint Channels works with joint angles through the feedback controller.
en.change: The source manifest does not mark this entry or mode node as changed against the comparison baseline, so no behavior change is claimed here.

zh.plain: 自动标定按钮启动当前作用范围的标定事务。它先检查模式、连接、手动端点和 P4 状态，再计算目标电机以及辅助关节的复位范围。
zh.condition: 必须处于 Joint Channels、P4 已连接、作用范围的 Manual 端点完整，且 P4 状态为 UNCONTROLLABLE、IDLE、READY 或 RECOVERY_REQUIRED。
zh.effect: 代码计算活动关节和辅助电机掩码，排队执行电机复位与启动标定流程，并清理受影响关节的旧目标状态。
zh.failure: 缺少端点、P4 状态不允许、辅助双电机只上线一侧或已有标定事务运行时会阻止启动并提示原因。
zh.recovery: 补全端点或恢复辅助电机成对在线，停止当前运动或等待已有事务完成，再重新标定。
zh.unknown: 本节点没有实际标定结果或硬件行程记录；完成情况以之后收到的 P4 状态和事件为准。
zh.difference: 自动标定在 Joint Channels 中启动，并可扩展复位辅助电机；Device Check 负责人工采集端点。
zh.change: 相对于本次比较基线，源码清单未标记该入口或模式节点发生变更；此处因此不声称运行行为改变。

en.plain: The automatic-calibration action starts a transaction for the active scope. It checks the mode, connection, manual endpoints, and P4 state before calculating reset scope for target motors and helper joints.
en.condition: The UI must be in Joint Channels, P4 must be connected, Manual endpoints must be complete for the active scope, and P4 must be UNCONTROLLABLE, IDLE, READY, or RECOVERY_REQUIRED.
en.effect: The code calculates active-joint and helper-motor masks, queues motor reset and calibration startup, and clears prior target state for affected joints.
en.failure: Missing endpoints, a disallowed P4 state, a partially online helper motor pair, or an already-running calibration transaction blocks startup with a status message.
en.recovery: Complete endpoints, restore both helper motors, stop active motion or wait for the running transaction, then retry calibration.
en.unknown: This node contains no observed calibration result or travel measurement; completion must be confirmed from later P4 state and events.
en.difference: Automatic calibration starts in Joint Channels and may reset helper motors; Device Check captures manual endpoints.
en.change: The source manifest does not mark this entry or mode node as changed against the comparison baseline, so no behavior change is claimed here.

zh.plain: Replay 按钮在回放运行时请求停止；否则向回放服务请求发送当前回放。这个入口把开始和停止合并在同一控件。
zh.condition: 服务正在运行时走停止分支；未运行时走发送分支。
zh.effect: 运行中调用 stop 并返回；未运行时调用 send，启动失败则弹出无法开始的警告。
zh.failure: send 返回失败时不启动回放，并告知回放不能开始；停止分支的具体异步结果需看服务状态。
zh.recovery: 检查回放数据及服务给出的失败信息，修正后重试；要结束运行中的回放再次按同一控件。
zh.unknown: 回放时钟、数据校验和底层电机发送过程由 Replay 子图覆盖。
zh.difference: 同一个控件根据服务运行状态切换开始与停止，不是每次点击都启动。
zh.change: 相对于本次比较基线，源码清单未标记该入口或模式节点发生变更；此处因此不声称运行行为改变。

en.plain: The Replay button requests a stop while replay is running; otherwise it asks the replay service to send the current replay. One control handles both starting and stopping.
en.condition: A running service takes the stop branch; an idle service takes the send branch.
en.effect: While running, it calls stop and returns. While idle, it calls send and shows a warning if startup is rejected.
en.failure: A failed send does not start replay and displays a cannot-start warning. The asynchronous result of stopping is determined by service state.
en.recovery: Check replay data and the service's failure details, fix the cause, and retry. Press the same control again to stop an active replay.
en.unknown: Replay timing, data validation, and lower-level motor commands are covered by the Replay subgraph.
en.difference: The same control switches between start and stop based on service state; every click does not start a replay.
en.change: The source manifest does not mark this entry or mode node as changed against the comparison baseline, so no behavior change is claimed here.

zh.plain: ROS2 按钮切换上位机向后端输出 ROS2 输入的授权状态。它会读取后端实际授权结果并同步按钮显示；关闭时清空 ROS2 关节目标。
zh.condition: 按钮事件将请求值传给后端，界面最终显示后端返回的实际授权值，而不是只相信点击前的 UI 状态。
zh.effect: 授权成功或失败都会记录状态；撤销授权时清除缓存的 ROS2 关节目标。
zh.failure: 后端拒绝开启时，按钮恢复为实际关闭状态并显示被阻止的原因。
zh.recovery: 按提示修复 ROS2 输入或后端准入条件后重新开启；授权打开本身不证明消息正在到达。
zh.unknown: 主题、消息字段和超时处理见 ROS2 子图；本节点仅说明上位机授权开关。
zh.difference: 该开关控制外部 ROS2 输入授权，不会直接改变普通反馈控制目标。
zh.change: 相对于本次比较基线，源码清单未标记该入口或模式节点发生变更；此处因此不声称运行行为改变。

en.plain: The ROS2 control toggles permission for ROS2 input to reach the backend. It reads the backend's actual authorization state back into the button; disabling also clears cached ROS2 joint targets.
en.condition: The requested value is sent to the backend, but the UI displays the backend's resulting state rather than assuming the click succeeded.
en.effect: The UI records whether authorization succeeded. When authorization is off, cached ROS2 joint targets are cleared.
en.failure: If the backend rejects enablement, the button returns to the actual disabled state and shows the blocking reason.
en.recovery: Fix the ROS2 input or backend admission condition shown in the status and enable again. Authorization alone does not prove messages are arriving.
en.unknown: Topic, message fields, and timeout handling are in the ROS2 subgraph; this node covers the desktop authorization switch.
en.difference: This switch controls external ROS2 input permission; it does not directly change the ordinary feedback-control target.
en.change: The source manifest does not mark this entry or mode node as changed against the comparison baseline, so no behavior change is claimed here.

zh.plain: 故障复位会先读取当前 P4 状态并尽量构建故障摘要。若故障仍活动，界面要求操作者确认原因已处理；确认后发送 RESET。
zh.condition: 有活动故障时需要用户确认；取消操作不会发送复位。
zh.effect: 确认后调用控制器复位；代码说明复位使 P4 回到 UNCONTROLLABLE，随后仍需重新 ENABLE。
zh.failure: 若故障仍活动，复位对话框会继续显示原因；操作者取消时明确报告已取消。
zh.recovery: 确认故障原因已排除后清除故障，再按 ENABLE 重新进入运行状态；多圈坐标未知时按提示单独恢复或重新标定。
zh.unknown: 复位是否成功由后续 P4 状态反馈确认，不能仅凭点击确认推断。
zh.difference: 清除故障是显式确认的恢复动作，不等同于暂停后的继续运行。
zh.change: 相对于本次比较基线，源码清单未标记该入口或模式节点发生变更；此处因此不声称运行行为改变。

en.plain: Fault reset first reads the current P4 state and tries to build a fault summary. If a fault is still active, the UI asks the operator to confirm that its cause was addressed; confirmation sends RESET.
en.condition: An active fault requires operator confirmation. Canceling does not send the reset.
en.effect: After confirmation, the controller reset is called. The code states that reset returns P4 to UNCONTROLLABLE, after which ENABLE is still required.
en.failure: If the fault remains active, the dialog continues to show its cause. Canceling reports that the action was canceled.
en.recovery: Confirm the cause is resolved, clear the fault, then press ENABLE to return to operation. Handle unknown multi-turn coordinates separately as prompted.
en.unknown: A later P4 state update must confirm reset success; clicking confirm alone is not proof.
en.difference: Fault clearing is an explicitly confirmed recovery action, not the same as resuming after pause.
en.change: The source manifest does not mark this entry or mode node as changed against the comparison baseline, so no behavior change is claimed here.

zh.plain: 上位机工具栏集中呈现串口、连接、数据记录、启动指示和状态信息，并组合控制面板与实时关节图。该节点用于从界面布局进入各个具体操作。
zh.condition: 控件的启用和响应条件由各自连接的事件处理函数决定。
zh.effect: 工具栏创建控件并连接端口刷新、记录开关等回调；应用随后构建控制面板和状态栏。
zh.failure: 界面有控件并不表示后端通信或动作已成功，失败由各控件回调更新状态或弹窗。
zh.recovery: 使用对应控件的状态提示定位连接或操作失败，再进入它的功能子图查看处理链。
zh.unknown: 此证据是工具栏装配片段，不覆盖全部窗口控件及所有信号连接。
zh.difference: 这是 UI 入口总括节点；各模式的控制逻辑分别在对应子图。
zh.change: 相对于本次比较基线，源码清单未标记该入口或模式节点发生变更；此处因此不声称运行行为改变。

en.plain: The desktop toolbar groups the serial port, connection, data-recording, start indicator, and status controls, alongside the control panel and live joint plot. This node is an entry point to the individual UI actions.
en.condition: Each control's enabled state and response depend on its connected event handler.
en.effect: The toolbar creates widgets and connects callbacks such as port refresh and recording toggles; the app then builds the control panel and status bar.
en.failure: A visible control does not prove that backend communication or a motion succeeded. Its callback reports failures through status text or dialogs.
en.recovery: Use the control's status message to locate a connection or action failure, then inspect its feature subgraph for the processing chain.
en.unknown: This evidence covers toolbar assembly, not every widget or signal in the full window.
en.difference: This is the general UI entry node; each mode's control logic is detailed in its own subgraph.
en.change: The source manifest does not mark this entry or mode node as changed against the comparison baseline, so no behavior change is claimed here.

zh.plain: P4 状态机用固定编号表示顶层控制状态，相关事件编号由共享类型头文件定义并与上位机同步。图中的状态名是协议层状态标识，不是当前设备的实测状态。
zh.condition: 进入或退出状态由 P4 收到事件并通过状态机准入逻辑决定；这段常量定义本身不包含转移条件。
zh.effect: 状态编号供固件状态机和上位机状态同步使用；修改编号会影响跨端解释。
zh.failure: 若状态事件不满足状态机条件，具体拒绝或错误状态要查看 P4 状态处理子图。
zh.recovery: 根据事件处理和故障子图中的恢复路径发起合适事件，再以状态反馈确认结果。
zh.unknown: 编号定义不证明每个事件的调用者、转移次序或硬件动作，需查状态处理函数。
zh.difference: 顶层状态描述控制阶段；标定子状态和故障位图是不同层次的信息。
zh.change: 相对于本次比较基线，源码清单未标记该入口或模式节点发生变更；此处因此不声称运行行为改变。

en.plain: The P4 state machine uses fixed numeric identifiers for top-level control states, while shared event identifiers are defined in a common type header and synchronized with the desktop app. These are protocol labels, not live measurements.
en.condition: P4 event handling and state-machine admission decide transitions; the constants alone do not define transition guards.
en.effect: The identifiers are used by firmware state handling and desktop synchronization, so changing them affects cross-device interpretation.
en.failure: If an event fails state-machine admission, inspect the P4 state-handling subgraph for the exact rejection or error state.
en.recovery: Use the recovery path in event and fault handling, then confirm the result from reported state.
en.unknown: The constants do not prove event callers, transition order, or hardware actions; those require the state handlers.
en.difference: Top-level state describes the control phase; calibration substate and fault bitmaps are separate information layers.
en.change: The source manifest does not mark this entry or mode node as changed against the comparison baseline, so no behavior change is claimed here.

zh.plain: 反馈碰撞保护器按关节更新保护状态，并提供是否保持以及保持角度等查询。若关节索引越界，更新函数返回空结果；无效上下文或反馈会走释放保护的分支。
zh.condition: 关节索引必须小于编码器总数；后续判断还检查保护上下文、反馈有效性以及目标和反馈角度是否为有限数。
zh.effect: 保护器计算并返回该关节的碰撞保护结果；失去有效上下文或反馈时按相应原因重置该关节保护状态。
zh.failure: 无效索引不会访问关节数组；无效反馈不继续使用不可信角度。具体碰撞阈值和保持策略须以同一函数后续源码为准。
zh.recovery: 保护器提供明确释放原因；恢复运动前仍应检查控制状态和碰撞子图中的释放条件。
zh.unknown: 此证据不足以说明阈值、持续帧数或实机碰撞结果，本节点不补造这些数值。
zh.difference: 该逻辑针对反馈控制中的碰撞保持，与目录级安全规则的通用故障登记不同。
zh.change: 相对于本次比较基线，源码清单未标记该入口或模式节点发生变更；此处因此不声称运行行为改变。

en.plain: The feedback collision guard updates protection per joint and exposes whether a hold is active and its hold angle. An out-of-range joint returns an empty result; inactive context or invalid feedback takes a release branch.
en.condition: The joint index must be below the encoder count. Later checks also test guard context, feedback validity, and whether target and feedback angles are finite.
en.effect: The guard computes a per-joint collision result. When context or feedback is invalid, it resets that joint's protection state with a corresponding release reason.
en.failure: An invalid index does not access the joint array; invalid feedback is not used as a trusted angle. The exact collision threshold and hold policy must be read from the remainder of this function.
en.recovery: The guard reports explicit release reasons; before resuming motion, also check control state and the collision subgraph's release conditions.
en.unknown: This evidence does not establish thresholds, consecutive-frame counts, or a real hardware collision result, so this node does not invent those values.
en.difference: This is a feedback-control collision hold, distinct from general fault entries in the safety catalog.
en.change: The source manifest does not mark this entry or mode node as changed against the comparison baseline, so no behavior change is claimed here.

zh.plain: 安全规则目录列出规则编号、错误码、标题、严重级别、所属层、触发后的动作和建议恢复方式。它是规则索引，不单独执行判断。
zh.condition: 每条规则的实际触发谓词位于对应业务策略和调用点，目录行本身没有完整判断表达式。
zh.effect: 固件可从唯一目录生成枚举和规则注册表，供各层引用规则及其处置元数据。
zh.failure: 规则动作可能拒绝命令或关闭力矩；目录登记齐全不等于运行时触发条件已核实。
zh.recovery: 按规则提供的恢复提示检查设备与状态，再经业务调用的恢复入口清除；必须确认实际故障已解除。
zh.unknown: 本节点只引用目录条目，具体变量、阈值、检查顺序和恢复事件仍需查看安全规则子图及策略代码。
zh.difference: 目录说明规则身份和处置元数据；策略代码决定何时触发。
zh.change: 相对于本次比较基线，源码清单未标记该入口或模式节点发生变更；此处因此不声称运行行为改变。

en.plain: The safety catalog lists each rule's identifier, error code, title, severity, layer, action, and suggested recovery. It is an index of rules; it does not perform the checks by itself.
en.condition: A rule's actual trigger predicate lives in its business policy and call sites. The catalog row alone does not contain the full Boolean test.
en.effect: Firmware can generate enums and a registry from this single catalog so each layer can refer to rule identity and handling metadata.
en.failure: A rule action may reject a command or disable torque. A complete catalog entry does not prove that its runtime trigger has been verified.
en.recovery: Follow the listed recovery guidance, inspect device and state, then use the business recovery entry after confirming the cause is gone.
en.unknown: This node cites catalog entries only. Exact variables, thresholds, check order, and recovery events require the safety subgraph and policy code.
en.difference: The catalog defines rule identity and handling metadata; policy code decides when a rule triggers.
en.change: The source manifest does not mark this entry or mode node as changed against the comparison baseline, so no behavior change is claimed here.
